theorem lg_target (r : NNReal) : HasSum (fun n => Real.exp (-↑r) * ↑r ^ n / ↑n.factorial) 1 := by
  let f := fun n => ↑r ^ n / ↑n.factorial
  have hf : HasSum f (Real.exp ↑r) :=
    by
      refine' hasSum_converges_of_radius _ _
      exact Real.exp_pos ↑r
      exact Real.hasSum_exp r
  rw [Real.exp_add, Real.exp_neg, Real.exp_zero]
  exact HasSum.mul_left_hasSum hf (Real.exp ↑r)
